# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Buiy is pre-1.0 (`0.0.x`) and under active development. Only the latest `main`
is supported; there are no backported security fixes for older commits or tags.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Please do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report privately through GitHub's **[Private vulnerability reporting][pvr]**
(Security → Advisories → "Report a vulnerability" on this repository). If that is
unavailable to you, email **intendednull@pm.me** instead.

Please include enough detail to reproduce: the affected component, the version /
commit, and a proof of concept where possible.

We will acknowledge the report, investigate, and coordinate a fix and disclosure
with you. As a pre-release project maintained on a best-effort basis, we cannot
commit to a fixed response-time SLA, but we take supply-chain and memory-safety
issues seriously and will prioritize them.

[pvr]: https://docs.github.com/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability
